notes: Seated on a wooden jhoola in a diya-filled courtyard on Lakshmi puja night, muse forties, full-length seated, symmetrical.
prompt: Editorial fashion photograph for an Indian handloom label's festive lookbook. Vertical 3:4 frame.

LIGHT: night, lit only by the sea of diyas: a warm golden underglow on her face and the gold foil, rich velvety shadows, the faint glow of more lamps in the distance.
CAMERA: full-length seated, perfectly symmetrical front-on composition, camera at seat height, 50mm lens at f/2, the rings of diyas leading into the frame.
